one_liner: Indian markets declined with Nifty 50 down 0.34% amid broad-based weakness.

drivers.title: Market Decline
drivers.detail: Broad-based decline with no single catalyst.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 930.9 Cr, DIIs bought Rs 1,968.17 Cr.
watch_next: GIFT Nifty suggests a positive start for Tuesday, 15 September 2026.
lesson_seeds: Market breadth was negative with more declines than advances.
HDFC Bank's legal win did not prevent share decline.
Hindalco's announcement was not enough to boost stock.
Volatility increased as indicated by the rise in India VIX.
